question: List all customers with their customer ID, names, and email addresses.
sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, email FROM customers;

question: Show all products with their product ID, names, and prices.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products;

question: List all orders with their order ID, order date, total amount, and status.
sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders;

question: Show all categories with their category ID, names, and descriptions.
sql: SELECT category_id, category_name, category_description FROM categories;

question: Find all products with their product ID, name, and price where the price is above 1000.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 1000;

question: List all delivered orders with their order ID, customer ID, order date, and total amount.
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'Delivered';

question: Show all customers whose names contain the letter 'A', including their customer ID, name, and email.
sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, email FROM customers WHERE customer_name ILIKE '%A%';

question: List every product with its product ID, name, and price, ordered from the cheapest to the most expensive.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC;

question: Show the five most expensive products with their product ID, name, and price.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show all orders placed after September 5, 2026, including their order ID, customer ID, order date, total amount, and status.
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders WHERE order_date > '2026-09-05';

question: List every product with its product ID, product name, and category name.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id;

question: Show each order with its order ID, customer name, order date, total amount, and status.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id;

question: List each order ID, product name, and quantity for every product included in an order.
sql: SELECT oi.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY oi.order_id;

question: Show each order ID, customer name, product name, and quantity for every product in each order.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

question: List every product name together with its category name and category description.
sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name, c.category_description FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id;

question: Show the order ID, customer name, customer email, order date, and total amount for all orders placed by customers whose email is available.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, c.email, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.email IS NOT NULL;

question: Show the customer name, product name, and quantity for every order item.
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

question: List all products that have appeared in an order, including their product ID and product name.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id;

question: Show the order ID, customer ID, order date, and quantity for orders containing the product named 'Mechanical Keyboard'.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, oi.quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Mechanical Keyboard';

question: List the customer ID, customer name, and email of all customers who have placed at least one order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.email FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

question: For each category, show the category ID, category name, and the number of products in that category.
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

question: For each customer, show the customer ID, customer name, and the number of orders they have placed.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

question: For each customer, show the customer ID, customer name, and the total amount they have spent.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

question: For each category, show the category ID, category name, and average product price.
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS average_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

question: For each category, show the category ID, category name, and maximum product price.
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

question: For each category, show the category ID, category name, and minimum product price.
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, MIN(p.price) AS min_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

question: For each order, show the order ID and the total number of items in that order.
sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id;

question: For each product, show the product ID, product name, and total quantity that has been ordered.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;

question: Show the total value of all orders as a single total order value.
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_order_value FROM orders;

question: For each order status, show the status and the number of orders with that status.
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

question: List the product ID, product name, and price of products that are more expensive than the average product price.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);

question: List the product ID, product name, and price of the products with the highest price.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products);

question: List the product ID, product name, and price of products that are cheaper than the average product price.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE price < (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);

question: List the customer ID, customer name, and email of customers who have placed at least one order worth more than 2500.
sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, email FROM customers WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 2500);

question: List the customer ID, customer name, and email of customers who have never placed an order.
sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, email FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);

question: List the order ID, customer ID, order date, and total amount of orders whose total amount is greater than the average order amount.
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders);

question: List the category ID and category name of categories containing at least one product priced above 2000.
sql: SELECT category_id, category_name FROM categories WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE price > 2000);

question: List the product ID, product name, and price of products that have never been included in an order.
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, price FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items);

question: List the customer ID, customer name, and total amount spent for customers who have spent more than the average customer spending.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > (SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS customer_total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) customer_spending);

question: List the order ID, customer ID, order date, and total amount for orders containing at least one product priced above 1000.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products WHERE price > 1000);
